Fallen Pass is for levels 19 to 44 [1].
Guard Pippi Pinecone is located in Evershade Weald [1].
Aashir's Journal is dropped by a cultist in Night Harbor [1].
Glass Flats connects to Sungreet Strand and Vale of Zintar [1].
Abbot Harrow is located in the Underdocks, specifically at the Temple of Ygorath [1]. The sources do not mention a character named "Harow," but Abbot Harrow is the only relevant NPC listed [1].

To make Enchanted Cloth, you need Cloth Scraps and Enchanted Powder [1]. You must use a Tome of Enchantment or an Enchanting Station in Night Harbor to craft it [1]. This recipe is for the Enchanting profession and requires a Start skill of 5 and a Trivial skill of 25 [1].
